title: Summary of Notifiable Infectious Diseases
content: MMWR : Summary of Notifiable Infectious Diseases Print Minus Related Pages Note: Beginning with data year 2016, links to annual data from the National Notifiable Diseases Surveillance System (NNDSS) are available on the NNDSS Data and Statistics web page at https://www.cdc.gov/nndss/infectious-disease/weekly-and-annual-disease-data-tables.html . The web page also has links to historical reports and information to help guide readers in their interpretation of these data.
